QUOTE: "**Allow list:** checked only inside `check_approval`. A match skips the approval callback. Allow does not override deny: a call that is both allowed and denied is approved, then blocked at execute time."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the allow list is consulted only in `check_approval` and only skips approval, with the deny check separately in `ServerManager::execute` (a different file, `server_manager.cpp`).
